0f4bf4e14d33bca31d9f3127f72b54ff71cea400.cause: brief 008 B3 second half: the world generator places a civic block's `dressing` (tools/world/civic: pieces, parasols, lamps, bollards, planters, cypresses, bands, civic crossing landings) and registers rules CD-1..CD-4; on a plan that carries streetscape.crossings.strip a tram stop's crossing patch lies at the carriageway's level, a bank patch is moved off a lawn, and SF-20 also holds the patch level and the lawn; the plan checker's walk reads the block's ground solids. Every one of these is opt-in on a block `dressing` or on crossings.strip, which no recorded plan or pinned block carries, so a recorded run regenerates what it was made with.
